items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We could take some lights along and just snap that the same time we do this picture of the Fitzbrothers.

ctx.x: We could take some lights along and just snap that the same time we do this picture of the Fitzbrothers. And she won't have to worry about it when you're in the house. That might be the best thing, yeah. And she wouldn't... She'd know she'd...
Yeah, but I mean it's mine. It's mine. It's hard to see it. She hasn't been in Madison for so long she wants to see it too.
